read_only_production_evidence: Actual definitions, ACL and configuration of four canonical functions, plus contact count and eligible-tag existence for the dedicated QA workspace only. admission: The committed request is disabled; all stages perform zero network or credential actions while disabled.
Only a public trusted-repository main push, with one parent, the first attempt and a diff containing only the request file can admit execution. Event and commit identities must match.

Requests expire within 30 minutes. Exact code hashes and bounded deployed web-byte hashes are checked before opening a session. The lead supplies the fixture-tag digest; literal tags and contacts stay in memory.
Existing withQaSession and serviceCredential are reused unchanged. No issuer, founder access renewal, Auth grant, credential retrieval implementation or product authorization bypass was added.

The browser fence permits only the dedicated workspace and two original nonces with exact synthetic payloads. Contact mutations, schedules, sends, duplicates, browser deletion, provider endpoints and unrelated queries are denied.
Cleanup has one hour of expiry grace, resolves only original receipts, and cannot open a browser or create drafts.
journey: Read Contacts and use its existing specific-tag handoff to the existing Email composer.
Save the first exact synthetic draft through the canonical receipt wrapper, reload the page, and reopen the actual saved row with matching fields.
Save the second draft, consume the actual successful server response, then deliberately reject it before the app receives it. Exactly two save POSTs are allowed.
Verify the real workflow marker contains only actor, SID, workspace and nonce. Carry only that metadata across reload in coordinator memory; do not restore the original payload.
Use the actual Check saved receipt control to recover the current canonical draft, then reload and reopen it again.

In finally, check or cancel both original nonces. Before canonical deletion, verify the immutable snapshot, exact current synthetic fields, draft status, actor, workspace and tag digest. Confirm removed receipt state and canonical list absence.

Attempt cleanup of the second draft even if the first cleanup fails. Preserve immutable receipts and cancellation tombstones. Evidence is written only after cleanup and local session logout are confirmed.
